body:
Agents get one written way to turn a UI/UX design into Lustre, so building from a design introduces few translation errors (feature:2fbf4ee3c8e49977).

### Do

- Add a reference section that maps each element type, property, size, token, variant and style override in the design format (D-230, D-235, D-237) to Lustre. Base it on what `render` already does, so the guide and the page's drawing agree.
- Say that a design is reference material: the agent writes ordinary code, and can keep or adapt the project's existing UI.
- Make it reachable through `help`, and from the task-run reference.
- It is for Lustre projects; say so.

### Acceptance

- A test that every element type and property in the element table is named in the guide, so a new one can't be added without it.

### Left out

Architecture diagrams, projects that don't use Lustre, and generating code.
title: from design: Lustre translation guide
